name: League Drift

cutoff.incorporated_through: All games fully finalized through Thursday Sep 10, 2026 (BR boxes/?date=2026-09-10 Standings Up to and Including this Date; MLB Stats API W/L match all 30).
cutoff.preference: Snapshot through last fully finalized games (Thu Sep 10).

rule: No fabricated MLB data. Ranks only on verified snapshot dates. Trails connect verified points; no interpolated ranks for missing days.
window: 2026-08-23 through 2026-09-10 inclusive — all 19 dates verified from Baseball-Reference (no interpolation).
rank_method: MLB rank 1=best among 30 by winning percentage W/(W+L). Unique order tiebreak: PCT desc, then W desc, then L asc, then abbreviation. League rank is the same method within AL or NL (15 teams).
gb_method: GB_mlb = ((leaderW-teamW)+(teamL-leaderL))/2 from verified W/L vs MLB PCT leader that date. ESPN page GB is vs AL or NL leader (two tables on group/league page), stored separately as espn_gb; not mixed into MLB GB.

sources.current_standings: current_standings.json (MLB Stats API through Sep 10 close; W/L match BR)

espn_crosscheck.note: ESPN markdown omitted team names; names recovered from ESPN standings API AL East plus matching unique W-L-PCT-STRK-L10 rows to current_standings.json.

unverified: Streak and L10 only attached on 2026-09-10 from current_standings.json / MLB Stats API (not available on BR daily tables).
Historical dates before 2026-09-10 do not include streak/L10 (UNVERIFIED for those dates — omitted).
ESPN GB is vs AL/NL leader; MLB combined GB is computed from verified W/L.
